findings.title: An id is matched before a title, so a title that looks like another task's id is ambiguous
findings.why: `find` tries `tasks.get(key)` (the id) first and only then `byTitle`. A task whose title equals another task's UUID can never be reached by its title, because the lookup returns the other task. Complete, remove and rename act on whichever task the id belongs to. This is unlikely with random UUIDs, but nothing stops a user from typing such a title.

findings.title: Two separate imports from './task.ts'
findings.why: `priorityProblem` and the `Priority` type are imported in two statements from the same module. The other files in the project (for example `summary.ts`) use the same value-plus-type pair, so this is a cosmetic inconsistency only.
